name: skillsentry
description: Audit Claude Code skills & plugins for supply-chain attacks before they run — npm-audit/Semgrep for AI agent skills. Free, never executes what it scans, zero runtime deps.

scripts.build:plugin: npm run build && rm -rf plugins/skillsentry/cli && cp -r dist plugins/skillsentry/cli && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('plugins/skillsentry/cli/package.json', JSON.stringify({type:'module',private:true,bin:{skillsentry:'bin.js'}},null,2)+'\n')"
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm run test:cov
